chapter.verse: Pasian leh Topa Zeisu Khazih’ sila ahi keimah Jeim in mun khempeuh ah kikhen thangin a om, pawl sawm leh pawl nihte kong hopih hi.
Ka u ka naute aw, ze-etna apawlpawl na thuak uh ciangin lungdam nading bek a hi ci-in na ciamteh un.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, note upna uh hong ze-etnate in thuakzawhna hong khangsak hi ci-in na ciamteh un.
Note in a neu kha beek kisam loin na kicin’ nadingun, thuakzawhna lungsim in kicing takin hong bawlpha ta hen.
Note lakah khatpeuh peuh in lungpilna a deih leh, kosiatna a nei lo, mi khempeuh a kigen thei lo-a a pia nuam Pasian kiangah thungen ta hen. A nget leh a ngah ding hi.
Ahih hangin um khial loin upna tawh ngen ta hen. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, upkhialhna a nei mi in huih nunga kilok thei tui kilok tawh kibang hi.
Tua bang mi in lungka mi, a hanciamna a bawlna khempeuh ah a kip lo mi hi a, Topa kiang panin bangmah a ngah dingin ki-um kei hen.
Mi kiniamsak sanggamte in a ngah a san’ na uhah kilungdamsak thei ta uh hen.
Sumhau sanggam in kiniamsakna a thuakna ah kilungdamsak thei ta hen. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, amah in lopa paak bangin mangthang hi.
Ni in a satna tawh hong suah ciangin lopa kung in keugaw a, a paak a vul thei a, a kilawmna a meelte zong a mangthang thei hi. Tua mah bangin sumhau mi in ama nate-ah vulin a mangthang ding hi.
Ze-etna a thuak zo mi in thupha a ngah ding hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ze-etna a thuak zawh khit ciangin Topa in a it mite a ciamna bangin nuntakna kumpi lukhu a ngah ding hi.

Mi khat in ze-etna a thuak ciangin, “Pasian in kei hong ze-et hi,” ci-in gen kei hen, Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, ahoih lo tawh Pasian a kize-et zo kei hi, amah in zong kuamah ahoih lo na tawh a ze-et thei kei hi.
Ama lunggulhna in kai a, zolna a thuak ciangin mi khempeuh in ze-etna a thuak hi.
Tua nung ciangin lunggulhna in gai-in mawhna a suak hi; mawhna in zong a kicin’ ciangin sihna a suak hi.
Ka it ka ute ka naute aw, na kikheem kei un.
A pha a kicing hong piak thupha a om khempeuh in khuavakna’ Pa kiang vantung panin hong pai uh hi. Tua pa in kikheel lo tham loin, kihei-in a lim zong a kiasak kei hi.
Ama pian’ sakte lakah eite in a gah masa bel i suah nadingin thuman thutak tawh ama deihna bangin eite hong piangsak hi.
Ka it ka u ka naute aw, hih thu na thei uh hi. Ahih hangin mi khempeuh in khuazak nading manlang hen, kampau nading ahi zongin, heh nading ahi zongin, manlang kei hen.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, mi’ hehna in Pasian’ dikna thu a piangsak kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin a kihhuai na khempeuh leh hazat luatna lungsimte paaikhia-in, na kha uh hong gum thei note’ lung sungah a kituh Pasian’ thu lungnemna tawh na sang un.
Note’ pumpi uh kikheemin thungaite bek hi kei un; thu banga gamtate na hi un.
Mi khat in thu zui lo-a a ngaih bek leh, tua pa in limlang ah ama maitang a en mi tawh kibang hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, a mai a et khit ciangin mun dangah pai-in ama meel bang ci bang mi ahi hiam cih a mangngilh pah hi.
Suahtakna tawh kizom a kicing thukham lim takin entel a, a zuisuak mi in thu a zak ciangin mangngilh loin zui ahih manin a sepna ah thupha a ngah ding hi.
Mi khat in, “Pasian ka bia hi,” ci-in amah a ki-up hangin ama kam a kham kei leh, tua mi in a kikheem suak a, ama biakna in a mawkna ahi hi.

I Pa Pasian mai-ah a nin lo, a siangtho biakna in pa nei lo naupangte leh meigong numeite a dah lai takun a en a keem thei a, ama pumpi zong leitung kihhuai nitna tawh kipelh nadingin a kikep theihna ahi hi.
